notes.title: v1.0 Update Now Live – New Character, Level, and Boss!
notes.content:
The full version is officially out now. This update introduces a new character, a new level, and a new boss. Get 30% off now!

[h2]New Character[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710381/3a8684c0867af8c1fc701a01a36302c14baf711a.jpg[/img]
Meet Yun, an Eastern general, spear master, and ranged combat expert.
She embarks on a lone journey westward, carrying the pride of her legion.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710381/7cfb0fcb2353721518042980151fe4f8b30e932f.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710381/5851b2af8d80d478891b756fb104a1387018bc44.gif[/img]

[h2]New Level[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710381/5f72fc4a5b6862d5148d8c386c0af8a80a6031cf.jpg[/img]
Enter the Void Realm and face powerful foes!
Unlock & Entry: Conquer bosses to unlock the corresponding Void Rifts. Step through to access the new level.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710381/baf6190490b8948e3290023e058be3c8cadee199.jpg[/img]

[h3]Face Three Major Threats[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710381/ab7a585a16c986bd1b211062a555ed7483e70db6.jpg[/img]
- Abyssal Aberrant
- Primal Devourer
- Eclipsed Reflection
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710381/54c68fcfe02b5f16ba9523e1b900b58a67c711b2.gif[/img]

[h3]Challenge the Ultimate Boss[/h3]
Astharoth Godshredder
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710381/726f2e14c892e0666630e91c0824f345e0fc095b.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710381/2efe6b79121711ac5f5d492f9a7ec4eb2767186f.gif[/img]

[h2]New Weapons[/h2]
- [Arthur] Gauntlets: Fast strikes, wall-smash damage!
- [Ginzo] Tachi: Wide, powerful slashes!

Other Updates
Added unique passive skills for the new character.
Adjusted control resistance for some bosses.
Added the ending animation.

Fixed an issue where enemies were slowed to immobility.
Fixed pathfinding issues for some enemies.
Fixed some animations for the new character.
Fixed spawn locations for exit enemies.
Bug fixes.

notes.title: v0.9.6.1 Patch Note
notes.content:
[h3]v0.9.6.1 Patch Note:[/h3]
*Updates
-Added an optional Intense Mode to skip some levels. Unlockable after 1-4.

15% discount is on, get your hands on it!
Beta branch is updated to v0.9.6.0, check out the update!

[h3]v0.9.6.0 Patch Note:[/h3]
*Updates
-Added an optional Intense Mode to skip some levels. Unlockable after 1-4.
-New difficulty options added: Advanced/Expert.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710381/e442ba86582b34810b730b6e5c55611b8aba2099.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710381/244a9e046c648e33655a34d939d0685d60f6de55.png[/img]

-Potions drop in boss fights, except on the highest difficulty.
-Dashes in attack moves and skills won't trigger bleed damage.
-Ranged attacks cause splash damage to debris.
-Enemy thrown weapons disappear upon return.
-In Chapter 3, normal enemies have more health, Bosses have less.
-Passive skills Dash Strike and Swift Pace now immune to traps.
-Cross Rune removes negative effects when triggered.
-Added options for auto-pickup/smart potion pickup.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710381/374548863a2100d7665ca7d4fb1632b1d0c64253.png[/img]

-Improved options menu, added notes for some options.
*Fixes
-Initial input settings interface adapted for SteamDeck.
-Bug fixes.

[h3]==> How to Switch to the Beta[/h3]
1. Go to your Steam Library and find Shadow of the Depth. Right-click on it and select "Properties..." from the menu as shown below:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710381/b0f00f7d1755c8aec43508617c16679bb0cf95b8.png[/img]

2. Click on "Betas" and then select "Beta" from the dropdown menu on the right side to switch to the beta.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710381/5bd81e31b4838d301fa89fe7c9efa7a1f391227c.png[/img]

3. To switch back to the default branch, simply select "None" in the same dropdown menu.

[h3]==> About Save[/h3]
1. When you switch to the beta, your save data from the default branch (the branch you're currently playing on) will carry over. If you have save data from a previous beta, you can also choose to continue from there.
2. When switching back to the default None, the game will load the last save data from the default branch.

[h3]==> Previous Updates[/h3]
We've rolled out several patches and updates to ensure a top-notch gaming experience for our players during June and July. Here's a summary of the versions and updated contents:

v0.9.5.8
Fixed an issue where rune names were not displayed in certain languages when the font size was enlarged.
Bug fixes.

---
v0.9.5.6
Fix Stephanie's hair texture.
Resolve issue when loading old dungeon progress.
Bug fixes.

---
v0.9.5.4
-Added new combat UI layout, configurable in options.
-Supports various screen ratios, such as 16:10 and 21:9.
-UI adapted for SteamDeck, with larger default font. Settings can be changed in options.
-Added configuration for item drop pop-ups, can be shown in the corner or hidden.
-Mini-map in combat shows exploration percentage.
-Performance optimization.
-Fixed issues with saving and loading the same level multiple times.
-Fixed some issues with the font enlargement option.
-Bug fixes.

---
v0.9.4.5
Fixed an issue where picking up the second weapon could cause the tutorial to get stuck.

---
v0.9.4.4
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710381/bbdb8e0f92ca18b83b68c632aaa0933d3baa9d6e.png[/img]
-Added a new weapon type for Arya - the Rapier.
-When Arya uses the Rapier, her special skill changes to Phantom Blade R, and it can trigger the original Phantom Blade passives. (Known issue: Blade of Infinity excluded)
-All characters can equip their weapons in the secondary weapon slot, allowing them to carry two of their own weapons.
-When carrying two weapons, you can switch between them in the pause menu. You can also enable auto-switch, which changes weapons when using corresponding skills.
-Healing Statues can restore the HP of summons and extend the duration of some summons.
-Rune Warehouse sorted alphabetically.
-In the Start Menu -> Others, you can reselect branch saves.
-Bug fixes.

---
v0.9.3.4
- Weapon statues now have weapon refinement function, allowing players to refine one attribute of the weapon. Refinement can be done using coins or diamonds.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710381/45c1507b2563fc35891819b3d0ef4335cdedf547.png[/img]
- The reset function of weapon statues is now renamed. Players can now reforge using coins or diamonds.
- Improved UI for selecting skill book themes.
- Dynamically adjust the random weight of skill book themes.
- Adjusted the appearance conditions of related passive skills like "Deadshot".
- Added new passive skills: Quiver, Chain Lightning, Throwing Master, Fire Master, Ice Aura, Thunder Master.
- Adjusted Frost Aura to deal damage to enemies.
- Localized names of original Fire Mastery, Frost Mastery, and Thunder Mastery have been adjusted.
- In normal and hard difficulties, adjusted the attack rhythm of the second Boss to increase player forgiveness.
- Adjusted the visual effects when Bosses are hit to reduce potential discomfort for players.
- Performance optimization.
- Bug fixes.

notes.content:
Our best discount yet is here! Purchase Shadow of the Depth now and enjoy a 15% discount. Don't miss out—grab it now and start playing!
At the same time, to provide a more stable and enjoyable gaming experience, we're launching a new beta, where you can try out the latest updates and adjustments before they go live.

[b]Updated on June 5, 2024 at 8:00 PM PT — We have relaunched the Beta branch, and the version has been updated to 0.9.3.1.[/b]

Switch to the beta using the steps below and be among the first to check out the new content. However, please be aware that you might run into some bugs that we didn't catch during our internal testing. We appreciate your understanding and support.
If you find any issues or have suggestions while on the beta, drop by the "Beta" sub-forum in the Steam discussion forums to let us know. We're keeping an eye on your feedback and will make improvements as needed. Once everything's polished, we'll roll out the updates to the main branch for everyone to enjoy.

[h3]==> How to Switch to the Beta[/h3]
1. Go to your Steam Library and find Shadow of the Depth. Right-click on it and select "Properties..." from the menu as shown below:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710381/b0f00f7d1755c8aec43508617c16679bb0cf95b8.png[/img]

2. Click on "Betas" and then select "Beta" from the dropdown menu on the right side to switch to the beta.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710381/5bd81e31b4838d301fa89fe7c9efa7a1f391227c.png[/img]

3. To switch back to the default branch, simply select "None" in the same dropdown menu.

[h3]==> About Save[/h3]
1. When you switch to the beta, your save data from the default branch (the branch you're currently playing on) will carry over. If you have save data from a previous beta, you can also choose to continue from there.
2. When switching back to the default None, the game will load the last save data from the default branch.

[h3]==> What's New in v0.9.3.0[/h3]
[b]The v0.9.3.0 update is now available in beta[/b]. Follow the steps above to switch to this test build and experience the new content.
- Weapon statues now have weapon refinement function, allowing players to refine one attribute of the weapon. Refinement can be done using coins or diamonds.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710381/45c1507b2563fc35891819b3d0ef4335cdedf547.png[/img]
- The reset function of weapon statues is now renamed. Players can now reforge using coins or diamonds.
- Improved UI for selecting skill book themes.
- Dynamically adjust the random weight of skill book themes.
- Adjusted the appearance conditions of related passive skills like "Deadshot".
- Added new passive skills: Quiver, Chain Lightning, Throwing Master, Fire Master, Ice Aura, Thunder Master.
- Adjusted Frost Aura to deal damage to enemies.
- Localized names of original Fire Mastery, Frost Mastery, and Thunder Mastery have been adjusted.
- In normal and hard difficulties, adjusted the attack rhythm of the second Boss to increase player forgiveness.
- Adjusted the visual effects when Bosses are hit to reduce potential discomfort for players.
- Performance optimization.
- Bug fixes.

[h3]==> Previous Updates[/h3]
Since the Early Access release of Shadow of the Depth on April 23rd, we've rolled out several patches and updates to ensure a top-notch gaming experience for our players. Here's a summary of the versions and updated contents:

v0.9.2.12
Updates
- Stephanie's Blink can evade enemies' attraction skills.
Fixes
- Fixed the issue where the player's clone would not act in certain situations.
- Fixed the problem where pausing sometimes caused the game to lag.
- Other bug fixes.

---
v0.9.2.11
Updates
- Reduced the turning speed of enemy boomerangs.
Fixes
- Fixed the issue where some passive skills do not improve after being upgraded.
- Corrected the help text for weapon statues.
- Other bug fixes.

---
v0.9.2.10
Fixes
- Fixed the issue where the game might get stuck in the sealed room in Chapter 2.
- Adjusted the tracking logic of the player's tracking projectiles.

---
v0.9.2.9
Update
- The trunk of the second Boss is no longer auto-locked during the hint stage.
Fixes
- Attempted to repair some achievements that had been completed when starting the game.
- Attempted to solve the issue where players may get stuck by walls.

---
v0.9.2.8

- The HP and MP attributes on the main weapon are now calculated for the character, increasing the HP and MP values of higher-level weapons.
- Temporarily removed the HP/MP/Luck attributes on the off-hand weapon.
Fixes

- Some passive skills can no longer be triggered by other passive skills.
- Ginzo no longer locks onto projectiles from Soul Absorb.

---
v0.9.2.7
- Fixed the issue where the Boss might not enter the second phase.

---
v0.9.2.6
Updates
- Increased the player's evade distance and adjusted the character's evade animation. (Short press for short evade distance and short cooldown; long press for longer distance and longer cooldown.)
- Added current level display to the character selection screen and included a manual entry in the menu.
- Added another second-stage form to the third Boss and increased its health.
- Removed the bleeding debuff in the hard difficulty.
- Some passive skills will no longer trigger Ginzo's ability to block projectiles.
Bug Fixes
- Various bug fixes.

---
v0.9.2.5
Updates
- Added completion rewards; increased Boss level chest rewards.
- Identified runes in the rune shop will not duplicate with those in the player's inventory, except when the player has collected all of them.
- Stephanie's X Mastery ability can now affect Unstable Explosion.
- Adjusted the appearance speed and attack animation of the stealthy wolves in Chapter 2.
- Replaced some icons.
Fixes
- Fixed an issue where the mini-map displayed item icons incorrectly.
- Other bug fixes.

---
v0.9.2.4
Fixes
- Fixed a potential crash issue.
- Adjusted the format of some in-game videos to avoid decoding compatibility problems.
- Other bug fixes.

---
v0.9.2.2
Fix
- Fixed the issue that may cause errors in selecting skill books.

---
v0.9.2.0
Updates
- Added the talent "Choose," which allows you to choose a specific direction when picking up skill books. It takes 3 talent points to fully upgrade. (It's an early-stage UI design at the moment.)
- Increased the number of uses for the talent "Possibility" by 1.
- Added 5 talent points that can be obtained. Existing saves will be supplemented with talent points for past levels.
Fix
- Fixed the level display of upgrade abilities when equipped with corresponding runes.

---
v0.9.2.1
Update
- Reduced the intensity of negative effects applied by enemies in high difficulty.
Fixes
- Fixed the automatic shooting of Phyllis.
- Fixed the issue that may cause errors in selecting skill books.

notes.title: v0.9.1.1 Patch Note
Early Access 0.9.1 Updates
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710381/4beebeed2f1ae6441b69ec6e21130112d64c3fcb.png[/img]
Hi all,
The EA version 0.9.1 includes the following additions & upgrades (compared to Demo 0.8.43):
1. Added special skills that require new key bindings to trigger. Each character now has a unique special skill, such as Arthur's block and Phyllis' Shadow Bow Assault (melee attack).
2. Added a locking function with two operation modes according to the setting options:
  - Toggle Automatic Locking: Press the lock key to toggle automatic locking.
  - Hold and Lock: Hold the lock key to lock onto nearby targets.
3. Added a player level system. Experience is gained through the game, and leveling up grants diamonds, talent points, runes, and unlocks new characters.
4. Talent system is now available. Talent points obtained through the player level system can be used to unlock/upgrade talents. Some of the previous talents have been adjusted.
5. Rune System: Players can equip runes for their characters. More runes have been added.
6. Three Major Chapters, each features 1 boss.
7. Character Unlocking: Increase the player level to unlock the characters.
8. Blood Options: Added blood color options and a toggle feature to blood.
9. Adjusted the difficulty settings. The normal difficulty of the EA version is between the normal and hard difficulties of the Demo version.
10. Added Steam Achievement.
11. Added more passive skills.
12. New soundtracks.
Enjoy gaming!
